messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT(sev=2) detected: router fallback cascade in eu cluster -> high fallback rate from 'quant-1' -> 'small-quant' variant; observed ~45% of requests rerouted in last 3m; some requests appear blackholed (no response within SLO). autoscaler heartbeat mismatch noted for pool eu-west-2-dedicated. link: https://telemetry/reorg/2163123456

miguel_oncall: seeing the same in graphs. fallback rate spike at 12:07UTC, concurrent 95p latency jump for requests routed to small-quant. paging now. I'm on it.

sara_ops: +1. are we sure it's variant mismatch vs real capacity shortage? recent deploy of quantized profile landed earlier today?

miguel_oncall: earlier job pushed a quantization profile to 'quant-1' at 09:20, but router policy still marks quant-1 as preferred. telemetry shows autoscaler reporting pool capacity as 0 for several hosts -> likely a metric shuffle/label mismatch.

chao_sre: look at router logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:06:58Z router[router-27]: fallback_policy.apply -> selected_variant=small-quant, reason=capacity_mismatch
2026-03-15T12:07:02Z router[router-27]: proxy->pool: send request to pool eu-west-2-dedicated/slot-43
2026-03-15T12:07:03Z pool-proxy[slot-43]: connection timeout after 3000ms
2026-03-15T12:07:03Z router[router-27]: request dropped -> no healthy backends
```
looks like router decided to route but backend reports unhealthy.

miguel_oncall: I can temporarily flip router to prefer-region=eu and disable cross-region fallback to stop cascade to smaller variants. That should reduce blackholing for EU customers. Any objections?

jen_product: do we have customers impacted? I already got one support ticket complaining about slow completions in EU. Handoff to CS?

miguel_oncall: quick impact assessment: approximate 2.6k requests/min affected, mostly completion workloads with seq_len>512 (higher token counts) failing to complete. Potentially 12% error increase globally for affected endpoints. Will update to incidents channel.

sara_ops: MIGRATE plan: 1) set router policy override: disable cross-region fallback for 30m. 2) change fallback strategy from "route-to-small-quant" to "failover-to-hosted-compatible" (hosted variant in same region) 3) force-mark impacted pool hosts unhealthy to trigger autoscaler to re-evaluate. 4) trigger a controlled pool scale-up.

miguel_oncall: executing step 1 now. running:
```
# temporary policy override
curl -XPOST "https://router-api.internal/v1/policy/override" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"scope":"eu-west-2","disable_cross_region_fallback":true,"expires_in_s":1800}'
```

deploy-bot: POLICY_OVERRIDE applied by miguel_oncall (id=ovr-2163123456) for scope eu-west-2, expires in 1800s.

miguel_oncall: applied. fallback attempts to other regions should stop. Observability: fallback_count for eu dropped ~80% within 18s.

chao_sre: running health sweep and marking unhealthy for hosts reporting stale heartbeat.
```
# mark unhealthy hosts
curl -XPOST "https://pool-api.internal/v1/pools/eu-west-2-dedicated/hosts/mark-unhealthy" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"hosts":["slot-43","slot-47"],"reason":"heartbeat-stale"}'
```

sara_ops: we'll also kick autoscaler to re-evaluate target.

miguel_oncall: scaling request issued:
```
curl -XPOST "https://autoscaler.internal/v1/scale" -d '{"pool":"eu-west-2-dedicated","delta":+12,"priority":"emergency"}'
```

deploy-bot: SCALE_JOB queued (job=scale-2163123499) requested by miguel_oncall.

chao_sre: autoscaler logs show it failed to read capacity metric from pool-proxy due to label rename in proxy export. looks like the quant-profile rollout earlier changed metric name from 'pool_capacity_available' -> 'pool_capacity_avail' and our autoscaler query wasn't updated. that explains 0 capacity readings.

miguel_oncall: oof. so router sees autoscaler report 0 -> triggers fallback to small variant -> small variant overloaded -> blackhole. we need a hotfix: restore metric compatibility or add a fallback path that checks actual ping to pool.

sara_ops: short-term: revert metric query in autoscaler to accept both names (OR query). I'll patch and roll policy rule to treat missing metric as "unknown" instead of 0.

chao_sre: pushing a fix to autoscaler query now. patch:
```
# autoscaler metric query (psuedocode)
capacity = query_metric("pool_capacity_avail") or query_metric("pool_capacity_available") or null
if capacity is null:
  treat as UNKNOWN -> trigger probe-based check instead of 0
```

miguel_oncall: while autoscaler patch lands, keep router override active. also changing fallback mapping to go to hosted-compat variant instead of small-quant.

jen_product: noted. I'll update support triage with mitigation steps and ETA for full resolution. telling CS to set expectations: degraded latency vs complete failures.

sara_ops: autoscaler fix deployed and validated in staging. pushing to production with canary.

deploy-bot: DEPLOYMENT started: autoscaler-query-fix (canary=2 nodes) by sara_ops.

miguel_oncall: canary looks good. capacity metrics now show realistic values for marked hosts. router fallback rate down to baseline.

chao_sre: running post-fix probes -> tcp connect to pool slots succeed, health checks passing. restarting any pool-proxies that had old metric exporter.

miguel_oncall: removing temporary policy override in 10m. leaving handoff for monitoring.

sara_ops: started post-incident checklist: create postmortem ticket, record timeline, attach graphs.

jen_product: customer impact note: RU-4523 reported timeouts 12:05-12:20 UTC for EU completions. recommending outreach if SLA-sensitive.

miguel_oncall: handing off to chao_sre for the 12:40-13:40 UTC watch window. I'm off pager for now but reachable.

chao_sre: ack taking oncall. will monitor for 60m. subscribing alerts and keeping policy override until autoscaler reports stable capacity for 15m.

incident-bot: PAGING: handoff recorded miguel_oncall -> chao_sre at 12:30UTC.

sara_ops: postmortem ticket created: https://tickets/internal/IN-2163123456. tagging eng-runtime, eng-oncall, eng-sre, product.

jen_product: add customer impact summary and timeline; CS will post update to affected customers.

miguel_oncall: quick notes for PM: root cause = metric label change in proxy exporter after quantization rollout -> autoscaler misinterprets as zero capacity -> router fallback to smaller variant -> overload and blackhole. contributing factor = fallback policy assumes 0=unhealthy rather than unknown.

chao_sre: leaving a remediation action list in ticket:
- ensure metric compatibility or strict CI for metric name changes (owner: eng-infra)
- make autoscaler tolerant to missing metrics (owner: eng-sre)
- make router fallback prefer hosted-compat instead of smallest variant (owner: eng-runtime)
- add e2e smoke for pool-proxy exports (owner: eng-runtime)

miguel_oncall: resolved for now. closing thread after watch window unless new alerts. great teamwork everyone. :heart:
